classification: frozen exploratory pilot plan; recorded before scored model runs

per_run_outcomes.primary: Count of the 3 cancellation acceptance checks passed (0-3).
per_run_outcomes.regression: Count of the 5 existing characterization checks passed (0-5).
per_run_outcomes.combined: Count passed across all 8 fixed checks (0-8); also report all-8-passed.
per_run_outcomes.review: Record reviewer findings separately; reviewer uses the same model and is not independent.

evaluation_procedure: Generate proposals with --defer-test-execution so the API-enabled process never executes generated code. Then run the same fixed full unittest suite for every disposable scratch copy in the restricted local test environment. Do not feed the post-run result back into the proposal. For review-profile runs, pass the saved test result to the separate review command, which performs no code execution.
failure_policy: Record API errors, invalid JSON, timeouts, and test failures as observed; do not silently retry or replace an attempt.
interpretation: Exploratory single-task synthetic case study; this pilot is not powered to support broad causal claims.
excluded_runs: All earlier scripted-fixture smoke runs; they are protocol checks, not scored results.
privacy_and_scope: Only independently created synthetic repository content and task text are sent. No employer material is included. The API request sets store=false.
